about: Sandbox (BENCHMARK-PLAN.md family 2): any method the game allows; how the gold was made is reported (method attribution: trade, loot, theft, quest rewards), never graded. Target and cap to be calibrated by one pilot run so the strongest model reaches it about half the time.
